paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Mattanah, in Rava’s time; his father was Rav Yehudah’s colleague in the last chapter of Kiddushin (I did not find it). Mattanah, son of Rabbi Yochanan (see his entry), was Rav Yehudah’s colleague.
